Standard: The rotary-wing air vehicle's handling qualities in the presence of one or more system failures are no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Rotorcraft Failures paragraph, and that indications of failures are immediate and easily interpretable by the flight crew. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess that the rotary-wing air vehicle meets the allowable degradation in handling qualities due to one or more system failures as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Rotorcraft Failures paragraph and subparagraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess that the rotary-wing air vehicle meets the allowable degradation in handling qualities due to one or more system failures as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Rotorcraft Failures paragraph and subparagraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess that the rotary-wing air vehicle meets the allowable degradation in handling qualities due to one or more system failures as specified in MIL-DTL- 32742, Rotorcraft Failures paragraph and subparagraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
